description: This PHP source file defines the Installer controller class within the Opencart admin marketplace module. It handles various functionalities related to installing, uninstalling, listing, uploading, and deleting marketplace extensions and modules within the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin panel.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: Controller class managing the installation, uninstallation, listing, and management of marketplace extensions within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the installation page with list of extensions and UI components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of extensions as a response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of marketplace extensions with pagination and filtering.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading and validation of new extension files (.ocmod.zip).

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs incremental installation of an extension, unzipping files, and registering paths.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates a new vendor autoloader file for extensions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes an installed extension, deletes files, and cleans up storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an extension's zip file and removes its installation record.
